freeze.objective: Masked pixel MSE + 1 * mean over patch/channel of squared mean error on valid core24.
freeze.rationale: Unit weight adds one equal-unit mean-error term; no weight search or hard centering of outputs.
freeze.selection_policy: Same494 train/186 control, seed, optimizer, batch and 2048 steps; final checkpoint only.

limits: Exploratory composition partitions only; no independent product qualification.
Translation-only alignment; local inconsistency may be motion or illumination.
Reference stability and pair gates are provisional, not calibrated quality guarantees.
Single-image Haar MAD conditioning is a texture/correlation-affected proxy, not sensor truth.
No noisy input interpolation; reference interpolation correlates target noise.
Pair admission uses low-frequency source/reference consistency, not learned output or high-pass residual masking.
Reciprocal translation and global overlap do not prove local correspondence.
Global channel gains/offsets fit on five ROIs; require two consistent distinct monitoring ROIs.
Burst means retain fixed-pattern noise and are not perfectly clean targets.
Exploratory composition partitions only; no independent product qualification.

Pair admission uses low-frequency source/reference consistency, not learned output or high-pass residual masking.

MSE is measured against a noisy aligned burst reference, not an absolute clean truth.
No independent final test, Lightroom equivalence, visual validation or production integration.
2048 fixed steps; no validation-driven checkpoint or parameter selection.
CPU-only training; no GPU, full-frame inference, peak-memory or deployment qualification.
Previously examined control, no independent final test or production qualification.
Single fixed mean-error weight, not an optimal hyperparameter claim.
Mean targets are noisy; centering errors may reflect physical signal differences or registration.
A lower bias does not prove improved chroma, preserved structure or visual quality.
No gradient loss, extra scenes, synthetic-noise injection or architecture change.
